The Massage Mentor LIVE is a channel where massage therapists and bodyworkers can watch interviews with leaders in the community and short videos full of inspiration. 

Now, there is more at The Massage Mentor Institute where you can sign up, log in, and take CE classes! There are over 120 classes waiting for you! https://www.themassagementorinstitute.com

 Diane Matkowski, aka The Massage Mentor and the creator of The Massage Mentor Institute, has been doing massage for 25 years. Her business is a nine t-time award-winning establishment and home to 13 successful massage therapists. She is the author of the book The Massage Therapist's Guidebook. She is a continuing education provider approved by NCBTMB. She has worked with famous gold medal athletes, TV personalities, and her business has seen over 12,000 clients. 
If you are a massage therapist and want some positive support, please join us:

https://www.facebook.com/groups/themassagementorclosedgroup/
